summary: Innovative Industrial Properties Inc filed a 424B5 supplement to register up to $500M in common stock and Series A cumulative redeemable preferred stock under an existing ATM program. The supplement discloses a $20M term loan from A.G.P. at 10% interest, maturing October 9, 2026, with weekly payments and default provisions allowing sale of securities. The filing is a routine shelf takedown and disclosure update for an ATM equity distribution agreement, not a special situation.
